title: Postdoc Position: Mathematical Relativity
about: Radboud University in Nijmegen, Netherlands, seeks a postdoc in mathematical relativity on non-smooth spacetime geometries, within the Vidi project 'Spacetimes near the Boundary of Existence'. Two-year temporary contract; preferred start 1 September 2027. Apply by 10 January 2027.
requirements: PhD in Mathematics, or expected before the start date
Publication record suited to career stage
card_alt: Card for "Postdoc Position: Mathematical Relativity" at Radboud University in Nijmegen, Netherlands; deadline 10 Jan 2027. The photo shows canal houses in Amsterdam, not Nijmegen.
